sourceSentences.text: He neither smiled nor bid her be seated.
Instead he simply demanded, ‘What were you doing in the aft hold?’
Someone had run to the captain and tattled.
She kept her voice steady.
‘I re-stowed the cargo.’
‘You did.’
It was a statement, almost an accusation.
But it was not a question, so she did not need to make any answer.
Instead, she stood very straight under that piercing gaze.
She knew he expected her to babble out explanations and excuses, as Keffria would have.
But she was not her sister, nor his wife.
He suddenly slammed his palm down on the table before him, and though the sudden impact made her flinch, she still did not speak.
She watched him waiting for her to say something, and then felt an odd sense of victory when his temper snapped.
‘Did you presume to tell the men to change how that cargo was stowed?’
She spoke very softly, very calmly.
‘No. I did not.
I did the work myself.
My father has taught me that aboard a ship, one must see what needs doing, and do it.
That is what I have done.
I arranged the casks as father would have had them done, were he here.
Those casks are now as every shipment of wine has been stowed since I was ten years old, bung up and bilge free, fore and aft, ends wedged off in the wings.
They are secure, and if they have not already been spoiled by jostling, they will be marketable when we get to Bingtown.’
His cheeks grew pink.
Althea wondered how Keffria could stand a man whose cheeks turned pink when he was angry.
She braced herself.
When Kyle spoke, his voice was not raised, but the longing to shout the words was clear in his clipped accent.
‘Your father is not here, Althea.
That is precisely the point.
I am the master of this vessel, and I gave commands as to how I wanted that cargo stowed.
Yet again you have gone behind my back and countermanded those orders.
I can’t have this interference between me and my crew.
You sow discord.’
She spoke quietly.
‘I acted on my own, by myself.
I gave the crew no orders at all, nor did I even speak of what I intended to do.
I have done nothing to come between you and the crew.’
She clamped her jaws shut before she could say more.
She would not tell him that what stood between him and his crew was his own lack of expertise.
The sailors who would have gone to their deaths willingly for her father now spoke openly in the forecastle of finding another vessel when next they shipped out.
Kyle was in danger of destroying the hand-picked crew that her father had spent the last decade assembling.
Kyle looked furious that she would contradict him.
‘It is enough that you went against my orders.
That is all it takes to challenge my authority.
Your bad example on this ship makes the crew restless.
Then I am forced to clamp down the discipline.
You should be ashamed for what you bring down on them.
But no. You don’t care one whit for that.
You’re above the captain.
Althea Vestrit is probably above almighty Sa!
You’ve shown the entire crew your complete disregard for my orders.
Were you truly a sailor, I’d make an example of you, one that would prove my orders are the only orders on this ship.
But you’re nothing but a spoiled merchant’s brat.
I’ll treat you as such, and spare the flesh of your back.
But only until you cross me again.
Take this warning to heart, girl.
I am captain of this vessel, and my word on this ship is law.’
Althea did not speak, but neither did she look aside.
She met his gaze levelly and kept as much expression off her face as she could.
The pink spread to Kyle’s forehead.
He took a breath and reached for control.
He speared her with his eyes.
‘And what are you, Althea?’
She had not expected such a question.
Accusations and rebukes she could deal with silently.
But in asking her a question, he demanded an answer, and she knew it would be construed as open defiance.
So be it.
‘I am the owner of this vessel,’ she said with as much dignity as she could muster.

He suddenly slammed his palm down on the table before him, and though the sudden impact made her flinch, she still did not speak. She watched him waiting for her to say something, and then felt an odd sense of victory when his temper snapped.

Вона знала, що він чекає, коли вона почне лепетати пояснення та виправдання, як зробила б Кефрія. Але вона не її сестра й не його дружина. paragraphPairs.sourceText: She spoke very softly, very calmly. ‘No. I did not. I did the work myself. My father has taught me that aboard a ship, one must see what needs doing, and do it. That is what I have done. I arranged the casks as father would have had them done, were he here. paragraphPairs.translatedText: Вона говорила дуже тихо, дуже спокійно. — Ні, не посміла. Я сама виконала цю роботу. Батько вчив мене, що на кораблі треба бачити, що потребує зробити, і робити це. Саме так я й учинила. Я розмістила бочки так, як розмістив би їх батько, якби був тут. Їх надійно закріплено, і, якщо їх уже не зіпсувала тряска, до прибуття в Бінгтаун вони лишаться придатними для продажу.

paragraphPairs.sourceText: Kyle looked furious that she would contradict him. ‘It is enough that you went against my orders. That is all it takes to challenge my authority. Your bad example on this ship makes the crew restless. Then I am forced to clamp down the discipline. You should be ashamed for what you bring down on them. But no. You don’t care one whit for that. You’re above the captain. Althea Vestrit is probably above almighty Sa! You’ve shown the entire crew your complete disregard for my orders. Were you truly a sailor, I’d make an example of you, one that would prove my orders are the only orders on this ship. But you’re nothing but a spoiled merchant’s brat. I’ll treat you as such, and spare the flesh of your back. But only until you cross me again. Take this warning to heart, girl. I am captain of this vessel, and my word on this ship is law.’
paragraphPairs.translatedText: Кайл мав лютий вигляд через те, що вона насмілилася йому заперечити. «Досить уже того, що ти пішла проти моїх наказів. Самого цього досить, щоб кинути виклик моїй владі. Твій поганий приклад на цьому кораблі тривожить команду. І тоді я змушений посилювати дисципліну. Тобі слід соромитися того, чого ти їх зазнаєш. Але ні. Тобі до цього анітрохи немає діла. Ти ставиш себе вище за капітана. Альтея Вестріт, мабуть, ставить себе вище за самого всемогутнього Са! Ти показала всій команді свою цілковиту зневагу до моїх наказів. Якби ти була справжньою морячкою, я б зробив із тебе показовий приклад, щоб усім стало ясно: на цьому кораблі є лише одні накази — мої. Але ти всього лише розбещене дитя торговця. Я так із тобою й поводитимуся та пощаджу шкіру на твоїй спині. Та тільки доти, доки ти знову не станеш мені впоперек дороги. Візьми це попередження до серця, дівчинко. Я капітан цього судна, і моє слово на цьому кораблі — закон.»
